name: voice ~Watashi-tachi no Sentaku~
source:
The applause and cheering keep ringing out. The thrill of it is coursing through my veins. I'll never forget this.

The story is set at a vocational school with a voice acting course. After the protagonist enrolls in hopes of testing her abilities, she meets [i]them[/i].

"Dreams, romance... for these two years, I don't plan on regretting anything​!"

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/22382]Freem![/url]]
translation:
掌声和欢呼声不断响起。那种兴奋感在我的血管里流淌。我永远不会忘记这一点。

故事发生在一所设有配音课程的职业学校。主角为了测试自己的能力而入学后，遇到了[i]他们[/i]。

“梦想、浪漫……这两年，我不打算后悔任何事情​！”

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/22382]Freem![/url]]
